games.title: Uno Arena
games.tagline: Based off the original card game, Uno! (who would've guessed)

_fields.file: Required. Exact .html filename in the repo (case-sensitive on GitHub Pages).
_fields.title: Name on the arcade shelf (overrides <title> scraping).
_fields.tagline: Optional subtitle under the title on each card.
_fields.tags: Strings used for filter chips (e.g. arcade, puzzle, multiplayer).
_fields.thumb: HTTPS image URL OR full data:image/...;base64,... string. Use img_dataurl_converter_for_thumbnails.html to paste a data URL. Empty = neon initial plate.
_fields.hidden: true removes the game from the shelf (still playable if you know the URL).
